def solve_sudoku(board):
    rows, cols, boxes = [0] * 9, [0] * 9, [0] * 9
    empties = []
    for i in range(9):
        for j in range(9):
            if board[i][j] == '.':
                empties.append((i, j))
            else:
                d = int(board[i][j]) - 1
                bit = 1 << d
                rows[i] |= bit; cols[j] |= bit; boxes[(i // 3) * 3 + j // 3] |= bit
    def backtrack(k):
        if k == len(empties): return True
        i, j = empties[k]
        b = (i // 3) * 3 + j // 3
        used = rows[i] | cols[j] | boxes[b]
        for d in range(9):
            bit = 1 << d
            if used & bit: continue
            rows[i] |= bit; cols[j] |= bit; boxes[b] |= bit
            board[i][j] = str(d + 1)
            if backtrack(k + 1): return True
            rows[i] ^= bit; cols[j] ^= bit; boxes[b] ^= bit
            board[i][j] = '.'
        return False
    backtrack(0)
```
